EmailTemplate.description: Template to be sent to customer community user upon activation of their user
EmailTemplate.name: Scoping Community Welcome Email with Header
EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome to {!Community_Name}!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Receiving_User.FirstName},
Welcome to our Scoping Community!
To get started, go to {!Community_Url}, logging in with Username: {!Receiving_User.Username} and the password you choose. Please be sure to write down your username and password for logging back in again.
If you forget your username and password at a later date, please email internalsf@atginfo.com requesting a link to establish a new password.
Once you are in the community, navigate to the Assessment relevant to your needs and fill out the necessary sections. If you'd like to pause and return to the assessment at a later time, just don't forget to hit save.
Once you have completed the assessment to the best of your abilities, with the assessment, check the "Finish Assessment" box on the final section of the questionnaire.
Thanks you! ATG Cognizant
